TDrawingObject.CanResize.text: Whether the object has resize handles. False for most objects.

TDrawMetaFile.CanResize.text: Yes: a picture has the eight handles of TinyCAD's rectangle tracker when it is the one selected object.

TDrawSquare.CanResize.text: Yes: a rectangle or ellipse has the eight handles of TinyCAD's rectangle tracker when it is the one selected object.

TDrawNoteText.CanResize.text: Yes: a note has the eight handles of TinyCAD's rectangle tracker when it is the one selected object.
